title: Opening an Account
desc: Open your first bank account and route your paycheck into it.
to-teach: Open a checking account from Actions and connect your income.
hints: Click '+ Checking' in the top Actions menu to open your account.
Drag a connection from your Job Salary node to your newly opened checking account.

client.name: Alex
client.description: Alex just graduated and landed an entry-level job, but needs to set up a bank account for direct deposit.
client.prompt: I just started my first job, but my paycheck has nowhere to go! How do I open a bank account and get my money deposited?
